argv:
n=0; failures=0; while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/root/prelink_ab_tools /root/prelink_ab_tools/readelf -dW "$f" > /root/prelink_ab_tools/one.dynamic 2> /root/prelink_ab_tools/one.err
    r=$?
    if [ "$r" -ne 0 ]; then printf 'READ_ERROR\t%s\t%s\n' "$f" "$r"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
    if grep -qF '(GNU_PRELINKED)' /root/prelink_ab_tools/one.dynamic; then printf 'GNU_PRELINKED\t%s\n' "$f"; fi
    n=$((n+1)); if [ $((n%100)) -eq 0 ]; then printf 'PROGRESS\t%s\n' "$n"; fi
  done < /root/prelink_ab_tools/elf_paths.txt
  printf 'SUMMARY\t%s\t%s\n' "$n" "$failures"
  test "$n" -eq 3208 && test "$failures" -eq 0; __ab_rc=$?; printf '\n__AB_RC__%d\n' "$__ab_rc"
